messages:
Maria (CS): quick check-in on OpalStream onboarding — flagged perf + cost drift. Customer on hosted redwood/gamma-3b, typical request size ~600 tokens, p95 latency 420ms, token spend up 28% month-over-month. Renewal discussion in 6 weeks, want to propose low-risk perf playbook: quantize + model swap + region routing. Thoughts?

Ash (ML Eng): Agree. Two-prong: 1) canary quantization to q4_0 for non-critical routes (10% traffic), 2) evaluate compact model as primary for low-latency routes. q4_0 usually gives ~1.6-1.9x token throughput on our infra; quality risk is small for their 512-ish prompts but we should validate.

Sam (Research): +1 on validation. I ran a quick offline diff on a 30-prompt sample yesterday — compact-mistral-7b kept intent for 27/30, hallucination delta +0.6%. Looks promising. Recommend fallback chain: compact-mistral-7b -> gamma-3b-q4. Also watch instruction-following regressions.

Evan (Solutions): Customer is bandwidth-constrained but wants improvements now. They're okay with 10% canary if we keep strict rollback triggers. Also asked about routing by region (EU users seeing higher latency). Can we do region-pref routing?

Ash (ML Eng): Yes — we can add simple route rules. Example snippet for their deployment config: 
```json
{"routing": {"policy": "latency-pref", "rules": [{"region":"eu-west-1","model":"compact-mistral-7b"}, {"region":"us-west-2","model":"gamma-3b-q4"}], "fallbacks": [{"model":"gamma-3b","pct":100}]}}
```
Set canary pct on gateway to 10%. Also enable prefix KV cache (prefix=256) to reduce repeated prompt cost.

Maria (CS): Good. Proposed rollout plan: Day 0 - deploy 10% q4_0 canary on non-critical workspace, Day 1-2 - run A/B on compact-mistral for eu-west, Day 3 - evaluate metrics and customer-facing evals. Monitor: p95, p50, token cost per request, top-5 regression prompts, and safety/hallucination rate. If hallucination delta > 1.5% or p95 increases >10% rollback immediately.

deploy-bot: Job queued: canary-deploy/opalstream-compact-mistral-2912345678 started by Ash.

Evan (Solutions): I'll book a 30-min sync with OpalStream CSM + AE tomorrow to walk the plan and get explicit canary approval. Also will capture renewal sentiment during the call.

Sam (Research): I'll push the 30-prompt eval and a 200-prompt extended run to the shared drive by EOD. Will include exact diff metrics (BLEU-ish, hallucination flags, token-cost delta).

Ash (ML Eng): I'll create the rollout config and enable KV prefix caching on the canary routes. Also adding a trace hook to capture per-call cache hit rate.

Maria (CS): Sweet. Action items: Evan -> customer signoff + renewal touch; Ash -> deploy canary + rollout config; Sam -> eval artifacts; Maria -> monitor dashboard and weekly summary for renewal thread. Tagging @here for visibility. :thumbsup:

Evan (Solutions): noted. I'll update the renewal playbook with this plan.

Maria (CS): Thanks team — check back here when canary metrics come in, we want this to be low-friction and reversible.
